(2) The scene transitions to a framed retro film effect where the woman is outdoors, biting into a light blue popsicle stick. (3) A green electric mosquito swatter is held up against the stone wall, moving slightly as if tracking something. (4) A close-up shot shows the woman's lower legs and feet wearing beige double-strap sandals on concrete steps. (5) The woman stands in front of a modern building with thatched elements, holding both the popsicle and the mosquito swatter, looking slightly perplexed. (6) The scene shifts to a wide beach at daytime under an overcast sky. The woman poses in a long black dress with side cut-outs. A small inset box zooms in on the dress detail. (7) She switches to a white lace crop top and beige wide-leg trousers, dancing energetically. (8) She appears in a white midi dress with cowboy boots, spinning on the sand. (9) She wears a cream-colored textured maxi dress, smiling and waving. (10) She wears a green striped mini dress with brown cowboy boots, performing a playful dance. (11) Back at the stone wall location, she wears the green mini dress and sunglasses, posing and gesturing towards the camera with a bright smile.
